user.title: Grid Load Shedding
user.description: Detect utility-grid power from a voltage sensor (e.g. a hybrid inverter's grid input) and turn selected loads off while it is gone.

data.name: Name
data.hold_seconds: Hold state while the voltage sensor is unavailable

data_description.voltage_entity: Grid is present while this voltage is above the threshold.
data_description.threshold: Usually the inverter's lowest accepted grid voltage (e.g. 170 V in UPS mode).
data_description.hold_seconds: Short dropouts of the voltage sensor keep the last state for this long.
data_description.fallback_entity: Optional binary sensor that is on while the grid is present (e.g. ping of a device powered before the inverter). Used once the voltage sensor has been unavailable longer than the hold time.

abort.already_configured: This voltage sensor is already used by another entry.

data.hold_seconds: Hold state while the voltage sensor is unavailable

user.title: Add load
user.description: This switch is turned off when the grid is lost (if it was on) and turned back on once the grid has been back for the restore delay.

error.already_configured: This switch is already a load.

forget.name: Forget shed load
forget.description: Remove switches from the shed list so they are not turned back on when the grid returns.

restore_now.name: Restore now
restore_now.description: Turn every shed load back on immediately and clear the list.
